import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] A = new long[20];

    static long recurse(int idx, long val) {
        if (idx == 0)
            return val == 0 ? 0 : 100000000L;
        if (val < 0) val = -val;
        long q = val / A[idx];
        long res1 = recurse(idx - 1, val - q * A[idx]) + q * idx;
        long res2 = recurse(idx - 1, val - (q + 1) * A[idx]) + (q + 1) * idx;
        return Math.min(res1, res2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        A[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
            A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        System.out.println(recurse(16, n));
        sc.close();
    }
}
